item.title: Vietnam to Limit Online Ad Skip Time to Five Seconds
item.description: Vietnam’s new regulation will require online video and moving image advertisements to allow users to skip them within five seconds, effective Feb. 15, 2026. This decree prohibits digital service providers from forcing viewers to watch unskippable ads longer than five seconds.

item.title: Spotify Expands Creator Monetisation, Opens Los Angeles Studio
item.description: Spotify is expanding its monetisation program for creators and introducing new tools for video podcasters. The move aims to enhance competition with platforms such as YouTube and Netflix in the growing market.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Health for Integrated Medical Records, Wellness Apps
item.description: OpenAI on Wednesday launched a new ChatGPT Health tab, allowing users to connect medical records and wellness applications, such as Apple Health and MyFitnessPal. The feature aims to answer health-related questions directly within the chatbot.

item.title: Razer Unveils Project Ava AI Gaming Assistant’s Physical Form
item.description: Razer has unveiled a new physical hardware device for Project Ava, its real-time AI gaming co-pilot, at CES 2026. This new version aims to make the AI assistant feel more physically present for gamers.

item.title: We Are Rewind Introduces Curtis Cassette Boombox to North America
item.description: We Are Rewind, a French organisation, has launched the Curtis cassette tape sound system in North America. The GB-001 boombox combines a retro aesthetic with modern technology, including Bluetooth 5.4.

item.title: Chinese Robot Autonomously Performs Pig Surgery with AI Model
item.description: A robot developed by a Chinese organisation successfully performed biliary surgery on a 30-kilogram pig, autonomously completing the procedure using an artificial intelligence model. The experiment, conducted by Shanghai MicroPort MedBot, took place on Dec. 24.

item.title: Volkswagen Taps Qualcomm for Future Infotainment Technology
item.description: Volkswagen plans a long-term supply deal with U.S. chip designer Qualcomm to deliver infotainment technology for the German carmaker's new software platform, having signed a letter of intent to make Qualcomm the primary tech provider. This collaboration aims to enhance future vehicle capabilities.

item.title: Warner Bros Discovery Investors Divided Over Paramount, Netflix Acquisition Bids
item.description: Some major investors in Warner Bros Discovery are divided over a sweetened offer from Paramount Skydance for the storied movie studio owner. The Warner Bros Discovery board considers the Paramount proposal inferior to its existing agreement with Netflix.

item.title: Meta Ray-Ban Display Smart Glasses See International Launch Delayed
item.description: Meta has announced a delay in the international release of its advanced Meta Ray-Ban Display smart glasses. The company revealed the product has "extremely limited inventory" and is a one-of-a-kind offering.

item.title: Xpeng Unveils Hybrid G7 SUV, Expands Global Strategy
item.description: Xpeng Motors has launched a new hybrid version of its G7 SUV, which the company states offers the world’s longest range for an SUV. The vehicle can cover 1,704 km on a single charge and fuel tank.
